reading: Anthropic says it has identified and disrupted attempts to use its AI model for "malicious activity" which could support the development of biological weapons.
The revelations in Anthropic's threat intelligence report come after a former top researcher at the company warned of the risks of AI to humanity.

The findings, made in the firm's recent threat intelligence report, are the latest in a growing series of warnings from AI researchers and industry insiders about the technology's potential risks to humanity.
The cases of concern detected over the past eight months ranged from fake dating apps and hotel Wifi scams to surveillance built to identify dissidents.
Claude, Anthropic's AI model, was also used by actors linked to a Russia-based cyber espionage campaign and by an Iranian propaganda institution, according to its report.

This includes Google, which wrote on Tuesday that a person had attempted to use its AI tool, Gemini, to obtain a "complete, step-by-step technical guide for synthesizing weaponised biological agents".
The lengthy report lists cases in which suspected state-sponsored groups, criminals, spyware vendors, state propaganda institutions, and politically motivated individuals misused its technology.
Jacob Klein, the head of threat intelligence at Anthropic, told the New York Times it was "an incredibly nuanced situation".
Anthropic stated, "The same information that can be used to develop a biological weapon could also be used to develop, for example, a vaccine or a cure for a disease."
The report comes after a top safety researcher at Anthropic warned AI is advancing so quickly he believes there is a greater than 10% chance it "could kill all humans" within the next decade.
In an article published on 6 September, OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki called for the industry to implement "voluntary slowdowns" until safeguards are set.
In the US, Democratic lawmaker Bernie Sanders has introduced legislation to ban AI superintelligence and temporarily pause advanced AI development.
Sanders emphasized, "When scientists tell you there is a chance, a chance that it could have a cataclysmic impact on humanity, you've got be a moron not to say, slow it down."
The California-based company said it had incorporated its findings into its processes "to better prevent, detect, and disrupt these activities in the future".
Anthropic also said it had shared intelligence with authorities and industry partners where appropriate.

vocabulary.definition: People within an organization or group who have special knowledge about it that is not available to the public.
Close observation, especially of a suspected spy or criminal, for monitoring purposes.
The practice of secretly gathering information about an enemy or rival country or company.
Information, especially of a biased or misleading nature, used to promote a political cause or point of view.
Combining a number of things to create a coherent whole, or creating a substance by chemical reaction.
Adapted for use as a weapon, or made more potent or effective as a weapon.
Companies or individuals that sell goods or services.
Characterized by subtle shades of meaning or expression, making it complex and difficult to understand fully.
Relating to a sudden and violent change, often with disastrous consequences.
A hypothetical intellect that surpasses the cognitive abilities of the smartest human brains across virtually all domains.

entries.ja: 組織やグループの内部にいて、一般には知られていない特別な知識を持っている人々。
entries.ko: 조직이나 단체 내부에서 일반에 공개되지 않은 특별한 지식을 가진 사람들.
entries.zh-Hans: 在某个组织或团体内部，拥有公众无法获取的特别知识的人。
entries.es: Personas dentro de una organización o grupo que poseen conocimientos especiales sobre ello que no están disponibles para el público.
entries.pt-BR: Pessoas de dentro de uma organização ou grupo que possuem conhecimento especial sobre ela que não está disponível ao público.

entries.ja: 特にスパイや犯罪の容疑者を監視する目的で行われる綿密な観察。
entries.ko: 주로 스파이나 범죄 용의자를 감시하기 위한 목적으로 이루어지는 면밀한 관찰.
entries.zh-Hans: 密切的监视，特别是为了监控目的对一名嫌疑间谍或罪犯进行的观察。
entries.es: Observación atenta, especialmente de un presunto espía o criminal, con fines de monitoreo.
entries.pt-BR: Observação atenta, especialmente de um espião ou criminoso suspeito, para fins de monitoramento.

entries.ja: 敵対する国やライバル企業について、秘密裏に情報を収集する行為。
entries.ko: 적대적인 국가나 경쟁 기업에 대해 은밀하게 정보를 수집하는 행위.
entries.zh-Hans: 暗中收集关于敌对国家或竞争公司情报的行为。
entries.es: La práctica de reunir información en secreto sobre un país o empresa enemigo o rival.
entries.pt-BR: A prática de coletar informações secretamente sobre um país ou empresa inimiga ou rival.

entries.ja: 偏った、あるいは誤解を招くような性質の情報で、政治的な主義主張や見解を広めるために使われるもの。
entries.ko: 주로 편향되거나 오해를 유발할 수 있는 성격의 정보로, 정치적인 목적이나 관점을 홍보하기 위해 사용되는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 用于宣传政治主张或观点的信息，尤其是带有偏见或误导性的信息。
entries.es: Información, especialmente de naturaleza sesgada o engañosa, utilizada para promover una causa política o un punto de vista.
entries.pt-BR: Informação, especialmente de natureza tendenciosa ou enganosa, usada para promover uma causa política ou um ponto de vista.

entries.ja: いくつかのものを組み合わせてまとまりのある全体を作り出すこと、または化学反応によって物質を生成すること。
entries.ko: 여러 가지를 결합하여 일관된 전체를 만들거나, 화학 반응을 통해 물질을 만드는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 将多项事物结合起来以创建一个连贯的整体，或通过化学反应创造一种物质。
entries.es: Combinar varias cosas para crear un todo coherente, o crear una sustancia mediante una reacción química.
entries.pt-BR: Combinar várias coisas para criar um todo coerente, ou criar uma substância por reação química.

entries.ja: 兵器として使用できるように改変された、または兵器としての効力や効果が高められたもの。
entries.ko: 무기로 사용하기 위해 개조되거나 무기로서의 효능이나 효과가 강화된.
entries.zh-Hans: 被改造用于作为武器，或者使其作为武器变得更强大或更有效。
entries.es: Adaptado para su uso como arma, o hecho más potente o efectivo como arma.
entries.pt-BR: Adaptado para uso como arma, ou tornado mais potente ou eficaz como arma.

entries.ja: 商品やサービスを販売する企業や個人。
entries.zh-Hans: 销售商品或服务的公司或个人。
entries.es: Empresas o individuos que venden bienes o servicios.
entries.pt-BR: Empresas ou indivíduos que vendem bens ou serviços.

entries.ja: 意味や表現に微妙な違いがあり、複雑で完全に理解するのが難しいことによって特徴づけられる。
entries.ko: 미묘한 의미나 표현의 차이를 특징으로 하여 복잡하고 완전히 이해하기 어려운.
entries.zh-Hans: 以细微的意义或表达差别为特征，使其复杂且难以完全理解。
entries.es: Caracterizado por sutiles matices de significado o expresión, lo que lo hace complejo y difícil de comprender completamente.
entries.pt-BR: Caracterizado por sutis nuances de significado ou expressão, o que o torna complexo e difícil de compreender totalmente.

entries.ja: 突然で激しい変化に関連し、しばしば壊滅的な結果を伴う。
entries.ko: 갑작스럽고 격렬한 변화와 관련되며, 종종 재앙적인 결과를 초래하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 与突如其来且剧烈的变化有关，通常伴随着灾难性的后果。
entries.es: Relativo a un cambio repentino y violento, a menudo con consecuencias desastrosas.
entries.pt-BR: Relativo a uma mudança súbita e violenta, muitas vezes com consequências desastrosas.

entries.ja: ほぼすべての領域において、最も賢い人間の脳の認知能力を超える仮説上の知性。
entries.ko: 거의 모든 영역에서 가장 똑똑한 인간 두뇌의 인지 능력을 능가하는 가상의 지능.
entries.zh-Hans: 一种假想的智能，在几乎所有领域都超越了最聪明的人类大脑的认知能力。
entries.es: Un intelecto hipotético que supera las habilidades cognitivas de los cerebros humanos más inteligentes en prácticamente todos los dominios.
entries.pt-BR: Um intelecto hipotético que supera as habilidades cognitivas dos cérebros humanos mais inteligentes em praticamente todos os domínios.
